purpose: Continue the stable frequent crypto trading and500%annual research. Test a new temporal information source, not more daily indicators. No guaranteed return, no real orders.
hypothesis: Opening-minute aggressor flow at UTC minute0/15/30/45 may be more persistent than equally spaced flow at7/22/37/52. Aggregate these separately within completed hours, control for ordinary whole-hour prices/volume/flow, forecast4h and12h. This minute-SPOT experiment is NOT an exact reproduction of the10-second FUTURES paper.

motivation.limits: Paper reports phase-specific predictability and tiny short-horizon gross magnitude relative to fees; it does not certify this strategy. Existing daily7dayflow learned experiment failed, so horizon and temporal aggregation change explicitly.

data: Official Binance spot1m ZIPs,2022-01-01 to2026-09-01 exclusive. Monthly published checksums, all same-month daily files on404 only. Two highly liquid user-permitted assets; no omitted missing months or invented quotes. Record raw hashes and aggregate-hour hashes. Complete60-minute support required; NaN hours and label gaps invalidate rather than fill. Source periods economically reused, not pristineOOS.
features: Common price/hourly-flow baseline: normalized1/4/12/24hreturns, ranges,close location, trailing24hmean distance, volume surprise, whole-hour imbalance1/4h, lagged hour volatility and hour/day sin/cos plus assetID. Boundary adds phase imbalance1/4h,phase turnover share,and phaseOI*close location. Placebo adds IDENTICAL dimensions from7minute-shifted phases. All3fits use identical rows.
learning: Monthly HistGradientBoostingRegressor, max_iter80,max_leaf_nodes7,max_depth3,min_samples_leaf128,learning_rate0.05,l2_regularization10,max_bins63,early_stoppingFalse,random_state20260906. No random validation split, optimizer or hyperparameter selection. Train last180days with>=90validdistinctdays and2000rows. Future4/12hlog-return normalized by168hvol*sqrtH, label clipped[-5,5] ONLY for training. Labels fully mature>=24h before fit month. Models begin2023. Exact versions pinned and every model exported as text nodes,never untrusted pickle load.
execution: New isolated historical event ledger, NOT modified old daily engine or autonomous controller. Entry at open2min AFTER an hourly feature closes; label and trade hold4/12h to another2min quote. One shared cash/BTC-or-ETH account,one position,no adds,flat after exact holding interval,at least1hour cooldown. Snapshot open prices not guaranteed live fills. Fresh entries need minute1 volume; capacity<=0.1% prior-minute volume, minimum10USDT, scenario lot1e-6BTC/1e-5ETH. No intrabar take/stop fills. Exits honor liquidity capacity, partial remaining holdings stay in EXITING state with no new entry.
risk: Fully funded spot,no borrowing. Primary entry budget<=25%cash and equity*0.0025/(2*horizon_vol+roundtripcost). These are sizing scenarios,not guaranteed. No permanent stop in base so failure cannot hide behind a stopped cash curve. Optional stop not introduced after results.
costs: fee0.1%+slippage0.05% EACH SIDE. Fixed primary forecast threshold gross log return>0.006,twice30bpsapprox roundtrip. No changing gate in stresses. Stress doubled costs,17minute entry/exit quotes instead of2,zero-cost ablation and1000USDT. Cost-free run remains diagnostic,not accessible venue price.
policies: Six paired models (base,boundary,placebo) x horizons4/12. Primary boundary4. Two controls cash and BTC buy-and-hold with same clock/cost convention. Every model tested on2023-2024,2025-Aug2026,and2023-Aug2026,independent starts without annual resets inside each account. No post-result winner selection.
robustness: Primary and matched base4 full/later doubled costs,17min delay,zero-cost fixed-gate ablation,1000cash. Primary later BTC-only and ETH-only permissions, models not refit. Gross fixed-fill breakeven-cost statistics reported as arithmetic, not new strategy. Report liquidity rejects,held gaps,residuals,active days,fills,completed trades,monthly signs,fullcalendar returns separately fromCAGR.
predictive_tests: Matched raw-label MSE for all3models on both horizons,2023-24 and2025-Aug2026,only labels matured before period end. Daily loss-difference7day-block bootstrap2000 samples: boundary versus base and versus shifted placebo. Overlapping labels and repeated research acknowledged; tests exploratory,not multiplicity corrected. Non-trading predictability is not enough.
admission: Primary only: full/later positive after costs,full marked-closeDD<=20%,laterdoublecost/17mindelaypositive,>=100completedlatertrades,incrementalerrorimprovement95%lower>0againstbothbase/placebo in bothperiods. Anyfail -> not admitted.500% separately requires actual fullcalendar years>=500%ANDCAGR>=500%,no annualizing a short sample.
verification: Minute timestamps/volume/finality,phase distinction,prefixcausality,futurelabels,embargomaturity,trainingrowparity,onecashaccount,feeandlotreconstruction,partialexits,gaprefusal,noignoredterminalpositions. Full root tests; a second clean runner repeats full reports and fill ledgers. Local tools currently returnClientError,so no local-execution claim.
operational_bounds: Finite CI computations only,no scheduled background work,no credentials,purchases,exchange submission,production defaults or writes to previously blocked controller.py/evaluation.py. Raw minute history can be large; retain manifest,raw archives and aggregate transformation for reproduction.
